title: Worship in the Church
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Worship in the church is the gathered response of God’s people to His glory, grace, truth, and saving work. The church worships through Scripture, prayer, song, confession, the ordinances, giving, obedience, and reverent joy.
summary: Worship in the church is the gathered response of God’s people to His glory, grace, truth, and saving work. The church worships through Scripture, prayer, song, confession, the ordinances, giving, obedience, and reverent joy.
christFocus: Jesus Christ makes true worship possible. Through Him, believers come to the Father, worship in Spirit and truth, and join the redeemed in praising the Lamb who was slain.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The church gathers to worship the living God. Worship is not first about human preference, performance, mood, or style. It is the right response of God’s redeemed people to who He is and what He has done.

Gathered worship is shaped by the Word. Scripture fills worship with truth, teaches songs, forms prayers, directs reverence, and keeps Christ central.

Worship includes joy and reverence together. God’s people sing, pray, hear the Word, confess sin, give thanks, receive the ordinances, and offer themselves to the Lord.

Because Christ is the center of worship, the church’s worship should proclaim the Gospel. The Lamb who was slain is worthy of praise from every redeemed people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Worship can easily become consumer-centered, performance-driven, or detached from truth. People may ask only whether worship moved them, not whether God was honored according to His Word.

This doctrine helps the church worship with both warmth and reverence. The goal is not manufactured emotion or lifeless formality, but Spirit-enabled, Scripture-filled, Christ-centered worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Come to gathered worship prepared to honor God, not merely to evaluate an experience. Sing truth, pray truth, hear truth, confess truth, and respond in obedience. Let worship shape your whole life before the Lord, not only your time in a service.
